pool.text: The Battle of Okehazama took place in Dengakuhazama, Owari Province.
Tokugawa Ieyasu moved the capital of Owari Province from Kiyosu to Nagoya.
Nagoya Castle was built.
Nagoya was proclaimed a city.
The musician Gorō Morita invented the Nagoya harp music instrument.
Mitsubishi Aircraft Company was established in Nagoya.
Air raids began with an attack on a Mitsubishi Heavy Industries aircraft works.
Nagoya Castle was hit and mostly destroyed.
The Enola Gay dropped a conventional pumpkin bomb in the Yagoto area.
The world premiere of the first Godzilla movie was in Nagoya.
The city was flooded and severely damaged by the Ise-wan Typhoon.
Reconstruction of the main building of Nagoya Castle was completed.
Oriental Nakamura was bought by Mitsukoshi from Tokyo.
Nagoya hosted the World Design Expo.
The large, modern Aichi Arts Center was opened in Sakae.
Nagoya Airport's commercial international flights moved to Centrair Airport.
Nagoya hosted the Nagoya Protocol conference.
The sister city relationship with Nanjing, China was suspended.
The MRJ's first flight took place.
Grant County International Airport became a sister airport.
